summary.text: Dave Hall is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 62, which he has represented since November 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Amy Huffman Oliver as his opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Dave Hall was born in Bedford, Indiana, lives in Norman, Indiana, and graduated from Brownstown Central High School in 2001.
He earned an associate degree in industrial technology from Ivy Tech Community College in 2003.

His career experience includes owning Dave Hall Crop Insurance, farming, and serving as a director of Jackson County REMC, and he served on the board of Owen Township and on the Jackson County Council.
Hall won the seat in 2022, succeeding Jeff Ellington, after defeating Greg Knott in the Republican primary and Penny Githens in the general election.
He won re-election in 2024 over Democrat Thomas Horrocks.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the House Local Government and House Natural Resources committees and as vice chair of the Utilities, Energy and Telecommunications Committee.
